sources.snippet: OpenAI CLIP ViT-L/14 at 336×336px input resolution, a higher-resolution variant of the standard ViT-L/14 CLIP model. The larger input patch size reduces information loss during tokenization, improving performance on classification tasks requiring fine-grained visual detail.

sources.snippet: Overview clip-vit-large-patch14-336 is a CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training) model built by openai using a Vision Transformer architecture with large patch size (14x14) and 336-pixel input resolution.
